summary: Design risk registers, task controls and safety reviews through applied exercises. Explore the five-day intermediate course and enrol.
lede: Safety program design connects workplace hazards to assigned controls, procedures and measures teams can review. For HSE officers, safety supervisors and operations leads, the course covers building risk registers, applying the hierarchy of controls and using job safety analysis to turn decisions into task instructions. Participants also work on contractor controls, incident investigations and indicators for tracking actions and reviewing performance.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who shape, operate or review workplace safety programs and need to connect hazard controls with daily work, contractor activity and management oversight.
modules: Hierarchy of Controls for Task Risk
Job Safety Analysis and Work Instructions
